causalSequence: cook pasta 1 min short of packet time; drain
melt butter; cook garlic briefly if using
stir in flour; cook out 1 min
whisk in milk gradually; simmer 3-5 min until thickened
off heat, melt cheeses into sauce; season
stir through peas, corn or spinach; fold in drained tuna, break into chunks
combine sauce and pasta in baking dish
top with grated cheese and breadcrumbs
bake 180-200 C, 15-20 min, until golden and bubbling
techniqueFacts: two sources build a classic roux (butter, flour, then milk); one whisks butter, flour and cold milk together in one pot as a no-fail shortcut
pasta is deliberately undercooked because it finishes cooking in the oven (2 sources)
cheese is melted in off the heat or on low so the sauce stays smooth (2 sources)
bake is short (15-20 min) — everything is already cooked, the oven only browns the topping
tuna goes in last, drained, broken into chunks rather than mashed
flavour levers vary by source: nutmeg + stock powder (1), lemon zest and juice (1), baby spinach (2)
topping is breadcrumbs plus extra cheese in 2 sources, seasoned breadcrumbs alone in 1
